subject.title: Voice-call plugin: hangup aborts in-flight tool calls (sessions_spawn killed before child initializes)

question: Should ordinary voice-call hangup allow independent `sessions_spawn` work that has begun child initialization to survive, and should that decoupling live in the gateway/subagent lifecycle rather than in the voice-call plugin?
rationale: The code shows a plausible abort and acceptance-order race, but deciding that hangup differs from explicit stop/reset changes product cancellation semantics across session lifecycle and subagent ownership.

options.title: Decouple accepted child spawn in gateway lifecycle
options.body: Treat voice-call hangup as ending the call surface while preserving already-starting independent child work, with regression coverage that explicit stop/reset still cascades.

options.title: Add plugin-local grace during finalize
options.body: Let the voice-call plugin wait briefly for embedded tool completion during teardown, accepting a narrower fix that may not cover other voice or lifecycle paths.

options.title: Keep hangup cancellation semantics
options.body: Document the cron/background-work workaround and close this as intended behavior if maintainers want hangup to cancel all in-flight call work.

recommendation.title: Decouple accepted child spawn in gateway lifecycle
recommendation.body: Treat voice-call hangup as ending the call surface while preserving already-starting independent child work, with regression coverage that explicit stop/reset still cascades.
